opportunities.title: Frictionless One-Time Pass & Sunk-Cost Free Tool Wedge Parity
opportunities.competitor_evidence: Acquire.com profitable micro-SaaS comps & Zola, Templett, Canva Wedding Print: Free 60fps interactive seating diagrammer (Sunk-Cost Endowment) -> $0 email Caterer Meal Sheet transport -> paid print-shop-ready 24x36 Poster Sign & Avery 5302 Escort Cards (watermarked proof -> 1-click unlock) + Wedding Planner B2B pass.
opportunities.hypothesis_plain_english: Ensure SeatHarmony (seatharmony.io) delivers an immediate interactive free diagnosis/specimen in <3 seconds with zero complex subscription account friction, gating only the high-labor multi-item deliverable behind a $0 functional email save or simple one-time pass.
opportunities.validation_check: Live prod end-to-end test: free specimen renders immediately; $0 email save and one-time pass checkout respond in <500ms.

opportunities.title: External Acquisition Flywheel (@mulak X/Twitter, Programmatic Comparison & Embeds)
opportunities.competitor_evidence: Zola, Templett, Canva Wedding Print organic comparison pages, GitHub/MCP store listings, and founder-led X/Twitter proof threads (@mulak)
opportunities.hypothesis_plain_english: Stop relying solely on localhost UI tweaks; ship shareable live benchmark/comparison proof pages and ready-to-post @mulak X/Twitter & community outreach artifacts with live verifiable data.
opportunities.validation_check: Live comparison/outreach asset is publicly reachable in production and linked from top navigation.

opportunities.title: 1:1 Competitor Color Harmony, Typography & 24px Spacing Rhythm
opportunities.competitor_evidence: 1:1 visual side-by-side against Zola, Templett, Canva Wedding Print (OpenRouter / Zola / Colorwise restraint): Editorial wedding typography (Cormorant Garamond, Title Case H1s), unique reception venue photography across all menu/template pages (zero text over photos, zero duplicate images), and clean mobile vs. desktop separation.
opportunities.hypothesis_plain_english: Eliminate both 'alien' neon colors/font-size soup AND dull/drab stripped grey layouts. Enforce a cohesive editorial/developer color palette, uniform 24px section spacing, Title Case hero H1s, and at most 2 clean CTAs per view.
opportunities.validation_check: Playwright live prod screenshot audit across desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px) confirms consistent spacing and zero CTA bombardment.

opportunities.title: Site-Wide Unique Photography Across All Top-Menu & Sub-Venue Pages
opportunities.competitor_evidence: Zola, Templett, Canva Wedding Print rich product/venue photography across every top-menu route and subpage
opportunities.hypothesis_plain_english: Deploy high-taste, unique imagery across ALL top-menu pages and individual venue/template subpages (never only the homepage, never repeating the same image twice on one page, never cutting off bottles/subjects with wrong aspect-ratio cropping, and never placing text overlays on top of photography).
opportunities.validation_check: Zero duplicate URLs on any single page, zero text-over-image overlays, natural aspect ratios preserved across all menu routes.

opportunities.title: Synthetic First-Time Buyer Walkthrough, Viewport Separation & Live Prod Parity
opportunities.competitor_evidence: Zola, Templett, Canva Wedding Print frictionless interactive UX & strict mobile/desktop viewport separation
opportunities.hypothesis_plain_english: Run a synthetic buyer walkthrough on live production: ensure every upload/preset/buy button works without freezing, mobile and desktop bars never collide on the same page, internal developer labels are replaced with plain buyer English, and all git commits are verified live in production.
opportunities.validation_check: Live production URL matches local HEAD commit and passes interactive click-through with zero console/network errors.
